title: Your OLED TV Screen Was Probably Made By LG — Here's Why - BGR
summary: LG and Samsung are the largest OLED panel manufacturers in the world, which means OLED displays from other brands are likely produced by either of them. That's why many wonder who makes the OLED panels for LG .
